summary: The timed CUDA-event loop repeats the requested count for every rank with local rows. Source partitions contiguous rows with matching values/columns/delimiters, rebases local row pointers, and gathers local outputs. The selected kernel maps one row per thread, loops over its full CSR interval and stores its sum. The sm_86 device image was inspected through its final store.
